title: Versatile Rewiring and Concurrent Resynthesis for High-Quality Customized Optimization
problem: Traditional logic synthesis algorithms reach saturation; need for substantial circuit structural improvements beyond standard methods.
motivation: High-quality circuit optimization requires exploring beyond conventional synthesis techniques.
method: Novel rewiring method using truth tables integrated with concurrent resynthesis framework; partitions circuits into support-limited subcircuits enabling rewiring at scale.
key_novelty: Integration of truth-table-based rewiring with concurrent resynthesis partitioning strategy for circuit optimization.
contributions: Novel truth-table-based rewiring method for circuit restructuring
Concurrent resynthesis framework with support-limited subcircuit partitioning
Synergistic deployment of multiple synthesis algorithms
Substantial improvements over strong baselines in node, transistor, and area metrics

metrics.area: Reduction in node count, transistor count, and area
metrics.other: Minimizes various cost functions including node and transistor count

limitations: Truth table approach limited to 16 inputs; scalability concerns for larger circuits despite partitioning strategy.
